title: Forever NASH
altText: Powerful graffiti tribute mural to writer Nash by Mr Blob at Overline Jam, featuring a character holding a stylized spray can and neon green smoke spelling NASH under a Rest in King tag.
description: Created for the international Overline Jam festival, this site-specific mural stands as a tribute to the memory of Nash, a legendary graffiti writer and historic figure who constantly attended and supported the jam.
